ns2:course.label: Industry-Linked Design Project
ns2:course.description: Emphasizes open-ended design projects which utilize principles of design, engineering analysis and functional operation of engineering systems. Projects are submitted and sponsored by industrial clients, design team developed, concepts visualized, alternatives evaluated and geometry created using CAD systems. Emphases on communication skills, technical writing, and interaction with industry representatives. Students operate in a team-based industrial environment with "real life" industrial projects. Prerequisite: One of ABE 361, CHBE 421, TAM 335; or credit or concurrent registration in ME 370.
